scripts.lint: echo "CRA does not provide a 'react-scripts lint' command; lint runs during 'npm start' and 'npm test'. Use 'npm run lint:clear' to clear ESLint cache."
scripts.lint:clear: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const targets=['.eslintcache', path.join('node_modules','.cache','.eslintcache')]; for (const t of targets){ try{ fs.rmSync(t,{force:true}); console.log('removed',t);}catch(e){ console.log('skip',t);} }"
